declare
 temp_sample_unit_days number;
 temp_autologous_unit varchar2(1);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :scoll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :sunit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :scoll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'Y'
 into temp_autologous_unit
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 donor_decision_code = 'S';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 temp_autologous_unit := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in trying to determine AUTO unit.');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_autologous_unit = 'N'
 then
 begin
 select nvl(sample_unit_days,100000)
 into temp_sample_unit_days
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error checking temp_sample_unit_days');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 temp_sample_unit_days := 30;
 end if;
 if :coll_date < :scoll_date or
 :coll_date - :scoll_date > temp_sample_unit_days
 then
 show_error('0211');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units, contracts
 where unit_id = :sunit_id and
 coll_date = :scoll_date and
 units.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 units.contract_id = contracts.contract_id and
 units.chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id and
 contract_type = 'TS';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0174');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking temp_sample_unit_days');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

declare

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 null_value VARCHAR2(1):='';
begin
 if :test_id is null
 then
 clear_record;
 else
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 first_record;
 loop
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.test_id','bold');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_test_desc','bold');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.test_seq_no','bold');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.test_result','bold');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_test_result_desc','bold');
 synchronize;
 :GLOBAL.return_val := test_results.update_auto_test(
 :unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,
 null_value,
 :absorbance,
 'TR:'||:sunit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_result,
 '9999',
 :banner.prog_name,
 sysdate);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message(:GLOBAL.return_val);
 message
 ('CORE routine for test results not run successfully');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.test_id','normal');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_test_desc','normal');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.test_seq_no','normal');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.test_result','normal');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_test_result_desc','normal');
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
end;
